title: Golden orb escorted by helicopters rising behind Secret Mountain

as_told.title: Golden orb escorted by helicopters rising from behind Secret Mountain

plain: Ross Coulthart, a journalist, says he was told that if you watched one spot over Secret Mountain in Arizona, you would see a big orb rise from behind the mountain with helicopters escorting it. He says that at 1:30 in the morning, sure enough, up came a gigantic, beautiful golden orb that pulsed and looked like glowing plasma; in one telling he calls the helicopters Black Hawks, a type of military helicopter, dates it to 2025 and credits a woman named Melinda Leslie, and in another he leaves out the pulsing. If true, it would suggest the military is flying or guarding something unknown there.
